title: Systems Resilience to Health & Climate Risks — ARTPARK @IISc - Leading AI & Robotics startup incubation
headings: H1: Epidemic Intelligence at Population Scale
text:
Epidemic Intelligence Platform

COVID-19 revealed the advantage of strong data systems and data-driven decision-making. The pandemic catalysed an innovation ecosystem across disciplines. Climate change, environmental factors and spillover events influence current and future population health challenges. ARTPARK is building an innovation infrastructure to enable better preparedness and response.

Epidemic Intelligence at Population Scale

Disease surveillance and population health management can benefit immensely from innovations across data, models and delivery. ARTPARK addresses this by creating a closed loop innovation-implementation ecosystem in partnership with the private sector, research institutions and government.

We work closely with systems to unlock siloed datasets and inform measures to improve quality and usefulness.

We work with innovators to generate new datasets

We create open data standards and toolkits as public good to democratize data processing.

We work closely with research institutions and the private sector to operationalise state-of-the-art models in implementation settings to solve population health challenges.
